facts.c: Any foreigner can apply for asylum to Cambodian officials by any appropriate means.
facts.q: Any foreigner can apply for asylum with competent officials of the Kingdom of Cambodia by any means available deemed appropriate.

facts.c: An applicant may stay only for the length of the procedure, on a free written authorisation: a visa in the passport or, without a passport, a letter signed by the Commissioner General of the National Police.
facts.q: The competent officials of the MOI shall issue written authorization for preliminary stay, free of charge, either in the form of entry visa on the Applicant's passport or in absence of a passport or any travel document, an explanatory letter duly signed and sealed by the Commissioner General of the National Police.

facts.c: Permission to stay lasts only as long as the refugee status procedure.
facts.q: length of stay is limited to the duration of refugee status determination procedure

facts.c: The applicant must complete, sign and return the application form within one week, giving in writing the reasons for fleeing.
facts.q: complete, sign and submit the form to the competent officials within a period not exceeding one week

facts.c: The interview takes place within 15 days of the form, before two Interior Ministry officials and one Foreign Ministry official, and is recorded.
facts.q: A refugee status determination interview shall take place within 15 days upon receipt of the application form by two competent and qualified officials from the MOI and 1 official Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Co-operation.

facts.c: A written decision is due within 45 days of the interview, extendable to 90 days in total.
facts.q: Within 45 days of the conclusion of the refugee status interview, a written decision shall be issued by the MOI. If the decision can not be issued within this time period due to the nature of the case, the competent officials of the MOI may extend the time period as appropriate, but not exceeding 90 days in total.

facts.c: After a refusal the applicant may appeal once to the Immigration Department within 30 days, stating the grounds.
facts.q: The Applicant may file an appeal with the Immigration Department for reconsideration of the decision within 30 days from the receipt of the adverse decision. The Applicant shall clearly specify the grounds upon which it is based. The Applicant shall be allowed to file only one appeal.

facts.c: A new panel of three officers decides the appeal within 15 days.
facts.q: The Immigration Department shall act on the appeal application within 15 days from the date of receipt thereof.

facts.c: The appeal decision is final, and a refused applicant must leave Cambodia within 15 days.
facts.q: Any decision concluded from the request for reconsideration will be final. The unsuccessful Applicant will have to leave the Kingdom of Cambodia within 15 days after the notification.

facts.c: A claim based purely on economic needs or wanting better living conditions can be rejected immediately.
facts.q: the Applicant shows that his or her application is only based purely on economic needs or just wishes to benefit from the better living conditions in the Kingdom of Cambodia

facts.c: A claim is also rejected at once if the applicant does not cooperate in giving accurate information.
facts.q: the Applicant does not cooperate with the competent official in clarifying accurate information regarding the application

facts.c: The procedure stops if the applicant misses the interview twice without good reason.
facts.q: The Applicant fails to attend the interview on two consecutive occasions without reasonable justification.

facts.c: A qualified interpreter is provided free at every stage.
facts.q: The Minister of the MOI shall provide a qualified interpreter free of charge in order to assist in each stage of the RSD process

facts.c: A recognised refugee has the same rights as a legal immigrant, gets a resident card, and may work or run a business.
facts.q: A refugee has right to work or to operate any kind of business in accordance with the laws and legal standard of the Kingdom of Cambodia.

facts.c: Refugee status is cancelled if it was granted on false information or documents.
facts.q: When it becomes evident that refugee status was granted on the basis of fraudulent information, document, or material which was willfully provided by the refugee

facts.c: Asylum seekers can approach UNHCR through the Ministry of Interior at any time.
facts.q: Asylum seekers can approach UNHCR through MOI at any time.

facts.c: UNHCR says Cambodia's General Department of Immigration oversees 26 refugees and 11 asylum seekers.
facts.q: In Cambodia, UNHCR provides technical support to the General Department of Immigration, which oversees 26 refugees and 11 asylum-seekers of various nationalities.

facts.c: UNHCR says challenges remain in access to asylum and efficient case processing in Cambodia.
facts.q: challenges remain in ensuring access to asylum and efficient case processing

facts.c: UNHCR has no programmes or staff in Cambodia; it is covered by the Thailand multi-country office.
facts.q: UNHCR neither has programming nor staffing in place

facts.c: UNHCR's office covering Cambodia is in Bangkok: 3rd A Floor, United Nations Building, Rajdamnern Nok Avenue, Bangkok 10200.
facts.q: 3rd A Floor, United Nations Building., Rajdamnern Nok Avenue,, Bangkok 10200

facts.c: UNHCR Bangkok's phone is +66 2 288 2180 and email thaba@unhcr.org.
facts.q: +66 2 288 2180 Email: thaba@unhcr.org

facts.c: Human Rights Watch noted the sub-decree gives no right to a court appeal against refusal, and no sign an appeal stops removal.
facts.q: The sub-decree provides no right to judicial appeal of a negative decision.

facts.c: Human Rights Watch said immediate rejection is a fast track with no appeal or review.
facts.q: This appears to be a fast-track procedure without any right of appeal or review of the immediate rejection of the claim.
